manifest.hypothesis: player_score in every tenant SQLite file has only PRIMARY KEY(id). GET ranking (1596 req over 3 runs, avg 1628 ms, 81 more answered 500 after 9.7 s) and GET player (1176 req, avg 2000 ms, one query per competition = 20 scans) filter by (tenant_id, competition_id[, player_id]) and sort by row_num, so each request scans the whole table (tenant 1: 1.67M rows) while holding the tenant flock. Composite indexes (tenant_id, competition_id, player_id, row_num) and (tenant_id, competition_id, row_num) turn the scans into range reads; rankings answer under 1 s, player workers stop leaving.

observations.summary: observe-baseline (3 runs aggregated): ranking 1596x avg 1628ms max 15439ms plus 81x 500 avg 9694ms; player 1176x avg 2000ms max 19196ms; bench log: 54 PlayerScenarioWorkers but 56 completed Player scenarios; Player+PlayerValidate = 1104 of 2378 points; no secondary index on player_score in sql/tenant/10_schema.sql; MySQL digests show only initialize statements (prepared statements undigested, 32k executes).

allowedChanges.reason: CREATE INDEX lines so tenants created by createTenantDB get the indexes
after copying initial_data, apply the schema's CREATE INDEX lines to every tenant_db/*.db so /initialize restores indexed files

manifest.changeSummary: Two composite indexes on player_score in every tenant SQLite DB: (tenant_id, competition_id, player_id, row_num) for player/billing/DELETE and (tenant_id, competition_id, row_num) for ranking; created in /initialize after the copy and in the schema for new tenants.
manifest.expectedEffect: GET /api/player/competition/:id/ranking and GET /api/player/player/:id drop from seconds to tens of ms on the big tenant, no more 500s from the 10 s timeout, more player workers stay; score up well beyond the +5% band (plan item 1). Risk: /initialize grows by the index build (baseline 4.3 s, limit 30 s).

ruleDecision.reason: median improved 505 bp but worst candidate 2269 does not clear best baseline 2378; noise not separated

override.reason: rule: inconclusive (median +505 bp, worst candidate 2269 < best baseline 2378). Override to promote: plan items 4 (dedupe+batch upload), 5 (reader lock removal) and 6 (ranking JOIN) need these indexes, and the candidate's per-endpoint log shows the index itself was not the lever: ranking avg 1628->1565 ms, player 2000->1590 ms although player now does 20 indexed lookups; the latency is queueing behind the per-tenant flock (plan item 5 moves up). initialize 4.3 s -> 14.9 s (index build on 100 files; limit 30 s). All three candidate samples >= the baseline median.
